verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers a developer API, webhooks, SDKs and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence item mentions a sandbox, test mode, test credentials, or any way to run against non-production data. The API docs describe only production authentication via mTLS and OAuth 2.0.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
